acceptanceCriteria.text: Normal PRs no longer execute the full real-canonical-Appliance OCI/bootstrap/golden-path composition chain solely because they touch host-bootstrap or another non-Appliance owner.
Appliance-defining PRs still build the canonical Appliance and verify its bounded manifest before merge.
Host-bootstrap/Route 3/4 PRs retain hermetic/fixed contract composition coverage before merge.
A trusted `main` push affecting Runtime/VM/Appliance/bootstrap integration runs the full canonical cross-boundary Appliance composition/golden-path certification.
Canonical Runtime Appliance artifact publication occurs only after the relevant trusted `main` certification succeeds.
Release publication remains exact-tag/revision bound and does not treat mutable `main` or PR evidence as release artifact identity.
A failure in trusted canonical integration is visible and attributable; it cannot silently publish an uncertified canonical artifact.
Same-PR stale-run cancellation and independent-main-SHA validation concurrency remain intact; only genuinely stateful publication is serialized if required.
Before/after evidence records PR critical-path reduction and trusted-main certification duration.
No real-host certification claim is made; #261 remains authoritative for Linux/KVM/Lima/QEMU external evidence.

issue.title: ci(runtime): move canonical Appliance composition certification to trusted main
